**Test image observations:** A mango leaf with brown necrotic lesions concentrated at the tip/upper portion, with scattered brown spots on the surface. The rest of the leaf is yellow-green. No white powder, no black sooty coating visible.

Plant part: **leaf** — all 4 classes are candidates.

Tip necrosis + scattered spots narrows to Anthracnose or Die_Back. Let me view one reference per class.

**Analysis:**

- **Powdery_Mildew**: White powdery coating — not present in test image. Eliminated.
- **Sooty_Mould**: Black sooty/dark spots all over leaf surface — not present in test image. Eliminated.
- **Die_Back**: Reference shows a uniformly brown, dried, curled leaf. The test image still has a green leaf body — doesn't match.
- **Anthracnose**: Reference shows brown necrotic lesions starting at tip/margins with irregular brown patches on a partially green leaf — closely matches the test image's tip necrosis + scattered brown spots pattern.

The test image shows tip-concentrated necrosis with irregular brown lesions on a still-green leaf, consistent with Anthracnose's "irregular brown to deep brown spots" and "semicircular lesions on margins."
